visual_action: A montage of two clips. First, Donald Trump is shown meeting and shaking hands with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in the Oval Office, with a Fox News chyron on screen. Second, Trump is shown speaking with Indonesian politician Prabowo Subianto in front of a backdrop of international flags.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: On-screen text states, "Trump's the type to make backroom deals..." and he is shown in all the video clips.

cast.name: Mohammed bin Salman
cast.evidence: Identified in the Fox News chyron as 'SAUDI CROWN PRINCE' meeting with Trump.

cast.name: Prabowo Subianto
cast.evidence: Identified by the on-screen subtitle 'Prabowo: Can I ... Can I meet Eric?'

cast.name: Eric Trump
cast.evidence: Mentioned in the on-screen subtitles of a conversation: 'Prabowo: Can I ... Can I meet Eric?' and 'Trump: I'll have Eric call you.'

on_screen_text.text: Trump's the type to make backroom deals with foreign leaders that just happen to enrich him and his family 🤫
NOW: TRUMP, SAUDI CROWN PRINCE MEET IN OVAL OFFICE
Prabowo: Can I ... Can I meet Eric?
Trump: I'll have Eric call you.
Trump: He's such a good boy. I'll have Eric call.

spoken_summary: The audio consists of a rap song with the repeated lyric, "I'm the type to hop on the flight with a warrant, you gotta catch me." The dialogue shown in on-screen subtitles between Trump and Prabowo is not clearly audible over the music.
audio_music: A rap track ('Vibración Guía' by Andrew James Cook) plays throughout the video, creating a swaggering or illicit tone that complements the accusation of 'backroom deals'.
editing_pacing: A quick cut between two different clips of Donald Trump meeting with foreign leaders.
central_claim: Donald Trump engages in corrupt 'backroom deals' with foreign leaders, using his political position to benefit his family financially.
intended_effect: To persuade the viewer that Donald Trump is corrupt and uses his presidency for personal enrichment.
